Tv Series: The Rookie Season 3
Song: Love Me Not

Rosalind Dyer locks Bailey inside a tank that’s slowly filling with water, then calls Nolan with an offer: hand himself over or Bailey dies in a few hours, and she gives him five seconds to decide 💧😱. Nolan gives in, but when he quietly tries to alert his friends during the drive, Rosalind catches him and punishes Bailey by opening one of the boxes, so the water rises faster 🚗😡. Once he arrives, Rosalind reveals her sick twist: there’s no shut-off switch in the house, and her accomplice Jeffrey will only free Bailey once he watches Nolan murder Rosalind in cold blood 🔪🎭. “I’m a killer, she’s a hero; you couldn’t possibly choose my life over hers,” she taunts, but Nolan can’t bring himself to take the shot 🔫💔. Then Bailey breaks out on her own and gasps for air, after four minutes and 20 seconds underwater, a new record, because she was never the damsel in this story 💪🔥.

snippet.title: She Cooked a Giant Uzbek Feast for Strangers… and Made Them Family ❤️
snippet.description:
A peaceful afternoon in an Uzbek countryside village, a group of exhausted travelers, and one little act of kindness that turned strangers into friends. ❤️

When Yuzu notices a tired elderly traveler and a little child sharing their last piece of bread, she decides to welcome everyone with something unforgettable.

She heads to her outdoor kitchen and prepares a giant traditional Uzbek-style lamb plov in an enormous iron kazan.

Watch every satisfying detail: washing the long-grain rice, slicing colorful golden and orange carrots, chopping onions, preparing tender lamb, sizzling everything in hot oil, adding fragrant cumin and garlic, and slowly cooking the rice until it becomes beautifully fluffy and golden.

The grand reveal brings together tender lamb that slides effortlessly off the bone, soft aromatic carrots, whole garlic bulbs and separate golden rice grains piled high on a magnificent traditional platter.

But the most beautiful part isn't the feast. It's watching tired strangers become friends around one generous table, sharing food, warm tea and a little happiness.

Sometimes, one generous meal is all it takes to make someone feel at home. 🌷

Long-grain rice
Tender lamb shoulder
Golden and orange carrots
Onions

Cumin and aromatic spices

snippet.description:
🚨🚨Imagery shows SS United States on an even keel on the bottom!  HUZZAH!🚨🚨
🚨Link to image: https://www.facebook.com/share/1E3QjxRYBj/🚨

In this episode of What's Going on With Shipping, maritime historian Sal Mercogliano examines the scuttling and final sinking of the historic superliner and flagship of the American Merchant Marine, SS United States, off the coast of Destin, Florida. Originally scheduled to take 45 minutes, the reefing operation stretched over eight hours into the night, raising serious questions about the vessel's final orientation and accessibility for recreational divers.

Key topics covered in this video:
🚢The 8-Hour Delay: Why the scuttling operation took far longer than planned and how William Francis Gibbs' robust naval architecture resisted rapid flooding.
🚢The Port List Analysis: Breaking down the dramatic footage showing the vessel listing heavily to port, air venting from portholes, and the stern settling first into 180 feet of water.
🚢Is She Sitting Upright? Reviewing Okaloosa County's initial sonar and ROV survey reports versus the pending physical dive inspections by Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution.
🚢Passing in the Night: The somber coincidence of SS United States passing the historic aircraft carrier USS Enterprise (CVN-65) en route to scrap in Mobile.
🚢Recreational Diving Impact: What an uneven keel or unexpected resting depth would mean for PADI recreational diver access at the 60-foot deck limit.
🚢A Legacy Remembered: Comparing the fate of SS United States to the tragic grounding of SS America and what this moment symbolizes for the American maritime industry.

snippet.title: Kader Sırrını Tolga'yla Paylaştı - Muhtemel Aşk 21. Bölüm
snippet.description:
Kader, Tolga'ya her şeyi anlattı. “BEN ÇOK HASTAYIM...”
Muhtemel Aşk 21. Bölüm izlemek için tıkla: https://youtu.be/yhbVB0a1yEo
(12 Kasım 2026)

Muhtemel Aşk Her Perşembe 20.00'de Show TV'de!

Kadir ve Defne, tüm aksiliklere rağmen yeniden evlenmeye hazırlanırken düğün telaşı iki aileyi karşı karşıya getirir. 

Selma’nın geleneklerden ödün vermeyen hazırlıkları, Defne’nin kendi düğünü üzerindeki söz hakkını koruma çabasıyla birleşince ortaya bol kahkahalı bir mücadele çıkar. Kına gecesi ve düğün, iki ailenin unutulmaz anlarına sahne olur. Ancak bu mutluluğun gölgesinde Kader’in herkesten sakladığı büyük bir sır vardır. 

Hastalığının son aşamasında olduğunu öğrenen Tolga, onu kurtarmak için çare ararken Kader ailesinin son günlerini güzel anılarla geçirmesini ister. Kadir ise kardeşinin mutluluğuna odaklandığı gecenin sonunda, tesadüfen duyduğu konuşmayla hayatının en ağır gerçeğiyle yüzleşir.

30’lu yaşlarında, kariyer basamaklarını kendi emeğiyle tırmanan Defne (Ayça Ayşin Turan), annesinin ona öğrettiği gibi hayatını hep kendi ayakları üzerinde kurmuştur. Güçlü, kontrollü ve alıştığı düzenden vazgeçmeyen Defne, bir gün aslında ne kadar yorulduğunu ve yalnızlaştığını fark eder. Belki de artık hayatında ilk kez gerçekten âşık olmanın zamanı gelmiştir. Ancak karşısına çıkan iki adam, her şeyi altüst edecektir. Kadir’in (Ekin Koç) doğrudan ve sarsıcı tavrı ile Tolga’nın (Feyyaz Şerifoğlu) dengeleri değiştiren oyunları arasında kalan Defne için artık hiçbir şey eskisi gibi olmayacaktır. Yanlış anlaşılmalar, kıskançlıklar, meydan okumalar ve kaçtıkça büyüyen bir çekim; izleyiciyi tutkulu bir aşk hikâyesinin içine çekecek.

snippet.title: Ukraine WIPED OUT the Drone Base Putin Needs to Advance | Pfarrer & Smart
snippet.description:
Ukraine struck Rubicon’s drone command base in Berdiansk, 107 kilometers (66 miles) behind the front, hitting a unit Putin relies on to sustain offensives. Footage shows more than 10 impacts at the base. Rubicon coordinates reconnaissance, strike drones, and electronic warfare for Russian brigades that struggle to do it themselves. Damaged control stations can deprive drone crews of targeting information they need before Ukrainian forces move.

Defense Minister Andrey Belousov concentrated elite drone operators, training, and funding inside Rubicon to compensate for ordinary brigades’ weaknesses. That made ordinary units dependent on specialists they could not easily replace. During Operation Vivaldi, Ukraine targeted Rubicon’s command networks, launch sites, and crews. Electronic emissions and heat signatures make these facilities easier to locate. Moving scarce experts to replace losses risks weakening other sectors.

Russian assault groups sometimes reach Ukrainian positions, but holding ground requires targeting, reinforcements, and timely orders. Strikes on Rubicon threaten the coordination groups need to advance and survive counterattacks. Moscow’s rigid command system leaves little freedom to improvise when links fail. Berdiansk losses remain unconfirmed, and backup communications may still work. Putin concentrated expertise to compensate for the army’s weaknesses. His brigades lack the skills Rubicon was created to supply.

Strikes on Rubicon threaten the coordination groups need to advance and survive counterattacks. Moscow’s rigid command system leaves little freedom to improvise when links fail. Berdiansk losses remain unconfirmed, and backup communications may still work. Putin concentrated expertise to compensate for the army’s weaknesses.
